title: Sloth with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='furG' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b07a4a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a5a30'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='faceG' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8c49a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d4a876'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body / head fur -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='34' ry='32' fill='url(#furG)'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='34' r='9' fill='#a06a3c'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='34' r='9' fill='#a06a3c'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='34' r='5' fill='#c48a5a'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='34' r='5' fill='#c48a5a'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='26' ry='24' fill='url(#faceG)'/>
  <!-- brow fur tufts -->
  <path d='M30 44 Q38 36 46 42' stroke='#8a5a30' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 44 Q62 36 54 42' stroke='#8a5a30' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='54' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#7a4c26'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='54' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#7a4c26'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='54' r='6' fill='#1e2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='54' r='6' fill='#1e2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='52' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='52' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='56' r='1.1' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='56' r='1.1' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <path d='M46 47 l1 2.5 2.5 1 -2.5 1 -1 2.5 -1 -2.5 -2.5 -1 2.5 -1 z' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <path d='M68 47 l0.8 2 2 0.8 -2 0.8 -0.8 2 -0.8 -2 -2 -0.8 2 -0.8 z' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='5' ry='3.6' fill='#5a3418'/>
  <ellipse cx='48.5' cy='62' rx='1.4' ry='1' fill='#8a5a30'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M44 68 Q50 73 56 68' stroke='#7a4c26' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- paws / body hint -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='16' ry='8' fill='#a06a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='84' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#c48a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='84' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#c48a5a'/>
</svg>
